mentions.name: Today I Will Destroy You
mentions.description: An action adventure game with Sekiro-inspired combat featuring a composure-driven knockdown system. The developer is starting playtests to evaluate the knockdown system and the difficulty and fairness of the sample boss fight, and is reworking the training mode so the game teaches players implicitly without explicit instructions.
mentions.problem: The training mode needed improvement so the game can teach players how to play without explicitly telling them how to play.
mentions.source_excerpt: This week I'll start playtests for the combat system of my next game, Today I Will Destroy You, an action adventure with combat inspired by Sekiro.
